en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a wide cobblestone road curving past several substantial brick buildings with multiple chimneys and fenced grounds. Pedestrians walk along the street lined with young trees and telegraph poles. At the top left is the caption in German 'Gruss aus Windau.' and along the bottom are captions in Russian and German identifying the scene.
